ResetFollowSteering.doc: Back to pointer mode unless the cursor is hidden.

SetClipping.doc: Resets the clip box to the full screen.

SetCursorIcon.doc: Switches the cursor icon. For the pointer icons 1100,1103-1105 the icon centre offset is half the icon size so the hotspot is centred.

comments.text: X2_SetControlMatrix(axis, function, set, flag): mode 0 = pointer axes

SetMouseMapping.doc: Maps mouse axes 512/513 to control functions per steering mode: pointer (11/12), follow steering (13-16), hidden/mouse look (1,2,4,5).

SetSteeringMode.doc: Public setter: while follow steering is disabled (count>0) a request for mode 1 is remembered and mode 0 is used instead.

UnlockCursor.doc: Unlocks the cursor and shows it if visible; in mode 1 refreshes the position.

UpdateCursor.doc: Clamps the cursor to the clip box, moves the icon, refreshes steering and sends NotifyMouseMove to the listeners (the first to accept it stops the chain, the rest get -1,-1), then refreshes the icon.

UpdateCursorIcon.doc: Asks the listeners (those with callback bit 4) for a cursor icon at the current position; the first non-zero answer wins, else the default pointer 1100.

UpdateCursorSteering.doc: Tells the engine whether the mouse steers the ship: follow steering is active in mode 1, and cockpit steering only if the active monitor is in cockpit view and the cursor is not hidden. Not active while the cursor is locked.

Vbi.doc: Per-frame: refreshes the cursor icon unless hidden.

comments.text: leaving mode 2 makes the cursor visible again
hidden mode releases the held-button flag

__SetSteeringMode.doc: Applies a steering mode: 0 pointer, 1 follow steering (needs an active-control monitor, else falls back to 0), 2 hidden cursor. Updates cursor visibility, monitors, mouse mapping and engine steering.

CreateAlloc.doc: Allocates a new B3D scene and wraps it.

GetState.doc: Returns the state of the request with the highest priority that is not 2 (no opinion); 2 if there is none.

comments.text: scene flag bit 1 = currently enabled

SetState.doc: Records a state request (0 = off, 1 = on, 2 = no opinion) with a priority under a key, then enables or disables the scene to match GetState.

comments.text: camera priority 140 for the subtitle camera
animation path 4678 drives the two subtitle bodies

CheckSubTitleInst.doc: Creates or frees the subtitle scene (camera priority 140, two animated bodies 10575 and 10576) depending on whether subtitle lines are active (m21).

GetMonitors.doc: Array of the three monitor objects.

HideCommWindow.doc: Hides the communication window by clearing its title.

Init.doc: Sets the default monitor state, allocates the monitor arrays, creates the three monitor objects (class 606) and sets the default views for monitors 1 and 2.

IsCommWindowVisible.doc: True while the communication window has a title.

OnCursorInvisible.doc: Notifies the monitors that the cursor is hidden; activates the main monitor when side monitor 1 was the active one, then hides the brackets and refreshes the visibility.

OnCursorVisible.doc: Notifies the monitors that the cursor is visible, shows the overlay brackets when no regular menu is open, and refreshes the visibility.

SetRadarOverlayVisible.doc: Refreshes the visibility after a radar overlay change. The argument is not used.

SetSceneState.doc: Empty stub in the intro object: does nothing.

ShowCommWindow.doc: Draws the communication window frame with a title and makes it visible.

comments.text: duration is scaled to 2/3 of the given value
a zero duration is computed by GetTextDisplayDuration from the text, with 70 as its base argument
a new subtitle is shown for 1500 ms before the first line advances
an appended line is shown for 1000 ms

ShowSubTitleText.doc: Shows a subtitle line (text array) for a duration. Arg3 forces the line to replace the current subtitle; arg4 is the priority. A line with the same priority is appended to the current one.

StopSubTitleText.doc: Clears the subtitle lines and redraws the subtitle bar.

comments.text: time of the last advance is stored after removing the first line

UpdateSubTitleText.doc: Advances the subtitle lines by time, drops the finished ones, and draws the first one in the subtitle bar at the top of the screen (1280 x 80 pixels). Moves the text 38 pixels right when the comm window is open.

Vbi.doc: Per-frame update: updates the subtitles, the display panel and the monitors, handles the pending monitor shortcut (key 704 switches the cockpit view or camera, key 707 activates the main monitor after a hold of 750 ms) and calls Vbi of each monitor.

620.doc: Manager of the movie-based cutscenes: plays one cutscene object (C621, dobj CAMERA) per movie id, waits for it, and keeps the list of intro/story movies already seen in the registry flags MoviesPlayed1. Called from the story scripts; its CallInfiniteLoop is one of the background loops started by StartInfiniteLoop.

comments.text: sets the bit for the movie in MoviesPlayed1 and saves it

AddMoviePlayed.doc: Sets the registry bit for the given movie id, so the movie counts as played.

CallInfiniteLoop.doc: Forwards the background-loop chain to the global CallInfiniteLoop.

GetCurrentCut.doc: Returns the current cut of the cutscene with the given movie id.

comments.text: pairs are {bit index in MoviesPlayed1, movie id}

GetMoviesArray.doc: Table of the story movies: {registry bit index, movie id} pairs.

comments.text: bit test on the MoviesPlayed1 registry int

GetPlayedMoviesArray.doc: Returns the movie ids whose bit is set in the MoviesPlayed1 registry value.

Init.doc: Creates the table of running cutscenes.

Input.doc: Passes an input event to every running cutscene; returns 1 when one consumed it.

IsPlaying.doc: Returns 1 while any cutscene is playing.

Play.doc: Plays a movie cutscene without freezing the player.

comments.text: waits in 100 ms steps while the cutscene reports IsPlaying

PlayAtPos.doc: Plays a movie cutscene and blocks until it ends. Replaces any running cutscene with the same id.

PlayWithFreeze.doc: Plays a cutscene and freezes the player for its duration.

Remove.doc: Stops and frees the cutscene with the given movie id, if running.

StartPlayWithFreeze.doc: Starts a cutscene with the player frozen and returns the cutscene object without waiting.

StartPlayWithFreezeAtPos.doc: Starts a cutscene at a position and returns its object without waiting.

Stop.doc: Stops the cutscene with the given movie id; returns 1 if one was running.

StopOneScene.doc: Stops one scene of the cutscene with the given movie id; returns 1 if one was running.

Vbi.doc: Per-frame update of all running cutscenes; removes and frees the ones that have ended.

621.doc: Cutscene player object (dobj: CAMERA) created by CutsceneMovies for one movie: plays the cut list of a movie, drives the cameras, environment takes and events. Only the class header and fields are named in this batch; its methods are in the next batch.

AddEvent.doc: Adds a scripted event to the callback table under key arg1 (key becomes element 0).

AddEventToTable.doc: Appends an event to the list stored in a table under a key (creates the list).

AddFrame.doc: Adds an event to the frame table; key is the take frame at which CutEvent 'frame' triggers it.

comments.text: switch picks scene+camera pair; the 3rd field (14) = space type 5/2/3/1
galaxy scene flag 4; system scale 1e-5 so the galaxy renders as a far backdrop
galaxy camera flags |= 0x400034, &= ~8

Create.doc: Creates a cutscene player for a mode: 11 = third cut scene, 7 = second cut scene, 8 = second composite scene, otherwise the main cut scene with galaxy and dust scenes plus an environment-map camera. Allocates the table state, a space object and a take, and wires the scenes.

comments.text: frame < 0 means the take is being skipped; only these commands still run
frame: run the event registered for this frame once
callback <id>: run the event registered under id
jump <cut> <variant>: clears the playlist and restarts with another cut
speak <textId> [face key]: speak a line; without arguments uses the pending event -1
endspeak: restore normal time speed
sfx <id> [duration]
startmovie <id> [texture 61] [flags]: plays a movie onto a texture
fadein <ms> [r g b]: fade from colour
fadeout <ms> [r g b]: fade to colour
firelaser <shooter> <target> [weapon] -> event type 1
firemissile <shooter> <target> <missile> -> event type 4
setcollision <obj> <on> -> event type 8
objecteffect <obj> <effect> -> event type 9
killobject <obj> <type> -> event type 10

CutEvent.doc: Receives text commands from the cut take (J3D events) and acts on them: frame, callback, jump, speak, endspeak, sfx, startmusic, startmovie, stopmusic, fadein, fadeout, firelaser, firemissile, setcollision, objecteffect, killobject. Negative frames (take being skipped) only run the commands that must happen anyway.

Destruct.doc: Frees the take, space object, all instances of the dust scene and every cut still in the cut table.

comments.text: main type 4 = planet
background type 1 = stars, 2 = nebula
flag 65536: no extra galaxy light

DoGalaxyTake.doc: Starts the galaxy-backdrop take and fixes up its instances: planets flagged, background star/nebula bodies swapped to the sector's, size 5 000 000, pass and alpha set. Adds a white light unless flag 65536.

DoOverlayTake.doc: Creates the overlay scene, camera and take for the given cut (used for movie screens).

EventAutoFire.doc: Schedules repeated laser fire events from startFrame for duration frames; spacing random in [min, max).

EventCheckObjects.doc: Schedules type-18 object check events at frame 1 for the given path objects.

EventFadeEffect.doc: Schedules per-frame alpha events fading an object linearly from startAlpha to endAlpha over a number of frames; exact end handling for fully visible (>250) or invisible (<10).

comments.text: interval between shots is 8-10 or 11-13 frames

EventFireGroupAtGroup.doc: Schedules random laser fire from every turret of each shooter to random targets of another group over a time span.

EventMakeInvincible.doc: Looks up each object but does nothing (empty loop, dead code).

EventSetInvisibleFromStart.doc: Schedules an alpha-override 2 event at frame 1 so the object starts invisible.

comments.text: event[1] is the event type
type 18: check that a path object exists (result unused)
type 19: start music event[2] with fade event[3]
type 14: speak line {voice, text} with a face; default face by voice id via the table below
speech flags: 16384, +4096 if face given, +131072 and face 1 for mode 1

HandleEvent.doc: Executes one scripted cutscene event {id, type, args...}. Arrays of events are expanded recursively. Types: 1 fire laser, 2 add laser to container, 3 add object, 4 shoot missile (multi-missile volleys for guidance bit 4), 5/6 speak question (6 also disables answers), 7 init answers, 8 set collision, 9 object effect, 10 kill object, 11 fire if in range, 12 fire at nearest enemy, 13 equip lasers, 14 speak with face, 15 alpha override, 16 flag toggle, 18 check object, 19 start music, 20 stop music.

Input.doc: Input filter during a cutscene. Key 752 (skip/Escape) ends the cut (waits for finish if flag 32 is set, silencing speech) and key 800 is swallowed while a menu is open. Returns 1 when consumed.

flag 8: composite scene visible
take id = cut id + 1000
flag 2097152: movie cut (id 6399); 1048576: movie cut id/10
flag 131072: dust scene on
benchmark hook after one second
flag 16 is the only flag passed to the take in normal cuts (skippable)
pending event type 7 entries are executed at the end
restore music: combat if alert else sector (not while warping)

PlayThread.doc: Main loop of a playback: for each cut in the list shows the scene layers selected by the flag bits, copies sector objects, sets scene parameters, starts the take and waits until it finishes, then resets the layers and moves on. Afterwards cleans up scenes, restores music and the benchmark counters.

ProcessEventTable.doc: Registers every list in the table as frame events (AddFrame).

ResetSceneMovie.doc: Frees the movie in a forked task.

ResetSceneParameters.doc: After a cut: stops the movie that SetSceneParameters started for cuts 6700-6709 (movies 900-909).

SetSceneMovie.doc: Plays a movie onto a texture during a cut. For cut 811 an extra movie 841 is played first. Stops composite effect 3 after playback.

6200: dark green fog and music 6200

overlay take for the cut (6480/6421/6401/6402/6333 are overlay cut ids)
6225/6230: sequence of type-9 object effect events
6624: EAX room change after 6 s
6399/6400: movie cut flags 2097152 / 1048576 added

SetSceneParameters.doc: Per-cut setup keyed by the cut id: resets fog, flags and aspect, then registers speech events (event type 14: {voice, text id, 1} at a frame), fog, EAX rooms, music, movies or special scene tweaks for the individual story cutscenes (6xxx = intro/story scenes, 8xxx = mission cutscenes).

comments.text: PlayMusicWithFade(track, 2000 ms, 1)

StartPlay.doc: Starts playing a cutscene list. arg1 may be {cut, flags, events}, {cut, variant, flags, events} or an array of those. Registers the events in the event table and starts PlayThread in a fork (freezing the player when requested), or stops the take if a play is already running.

Stop.doc: Stops the current take. Same code as StopOneScene.

StopGalaxyTake.doc: Frees the galaxy take and its light.

StopOneScene.doc: Stops the current take (the playlist continues with the next cut).

StopOverlayTake.doc: Frees the overlay take, cut, camera and scene.

Vbi.doc: Per frame: copies the cutscene camera rotation and focus onto the galaxy camera and updates the dust scene.

GetNotifyObject.doc: Notify object of the open box, else 0.

GetRequest.doc: Request id of the open box, else 0.

IsOpen.doc: True while the box is shown.

NotifyClick.doc: Mouse click: left button on a button closes with its value, on the close button aborts. Always swallows the click.

NotifyMouseMove.doc: Updates close-button hover and highlighted button, playing sample 957 on change.

comments.text: no button selected: fall back to OK

Open.doc: Opens a box with standard buttons chosen by a bit mask: 1 yes, 2 no, 4 ok, 8 a custom label (35:4270). Result value = the bit of the pressed button.

buttons are centred; each is label width + 40 wide with 12 px gaps
body gfx effects/menugfx/GUI/messagebox
sample 953 = open sound
listen to input (priority 90)

OpenCustom.doc: Opens a box with arbitrary buttons. Measures the text and labels, sizes the window (256..512 wide, max 256 high, text truncated with '...'), allocates scene, camera and body instance, and registers as input listener. Closes sidebar and context menus first. Returns 1 on success.

ShowMessage.doc: Shows an OK-only message in a fork. Unless force is set it waits until a previous box is closed.

CallInfiniteLoop.doc: Walks a table of class ids: calls CallInfiniteLoop on each class that has it (removing the entry first), and ends in InfiniteLoop.

CheckString.doc: Truncates text with '...' so that it fits the pixel width in the small menu font (gSmallFont).

CheckStringLarge.doc: Truncates text with '...' so that it fits the pixel width in the large menu font (gLargeFont).

DrawIcon.doc: Draws an icon from the icon data table for the given group and index, falling back to a fixed atlas cell when no icon data exists.

DrawMaximiseButton.doc: Draws the maximise/restore window button with icons chosen by arg4 (maximised) and arg5 (hover).

DrawMenuButton.doc: Draws a text menu button of width arg5 with label arg2. arg6 = selected, arg7 = highlighted.

DrawMenuLineButton.doc: Draws a horizontal menu line button. Style from flags arg5: 64 = pressed, 1 = active, else normal.

flag 16: header bar with tiled gradient
background darkening texture director/images/dark.tga

DrawMenuWindow.doc: Draws a framed menu window of size arg4 x arg5 at arg2,arg3 from the GUI atlas: corners, tiled edges and body. Optional title (arg7), icon (arg6) and flags arg8 (16 = header bar, 1 = title colour); arg9 is an optional background texture.

DrawPanel.doc: Draws a nine-slice panel of size arg4 x arg5 from the GUI atlas.

comments.text: clipping against limit arg8 and limit - 415

DrawSelectionRect.doc: Draws a selection rectangle clipped to the visible range arg8: the part left of arg8, the part inside the 415-pixel band and the part left of that band.

DrawShieldHullBar.doc: Draws a shield or hull bar: value arg6 out of arg5 scaled to the bar width arg4, split into 5-unit blocks. Sub-row selected by arg7 (0 shield, 4 hull).

DrawTipWindow.doc: Draws a tooltip window of size arg4 x arg5 with fixed header (8 px) and footer (52 px) parts.

comments.text: button style: 64 pressed, 1 active, else normal

DrawWindowButton.doc: Draws a window title button of type arg4 (0..8, 14, 15). Style from flags arg5: 64 pressed, 1 active. Other types are not drawn.

GetDateString.doc: Formats a duration in seconds: d-hh:mm when at least one day, else hh:mm:ss.

GetIngameDateString.doc: Formats game time in seconds as ingame date and time (year-month-day hh:mm) using a 360-day year of 12 months of 30 days, offset by the game start day.

GetLargeMoneyBillions.doc: Money amounts above 32 bit are stored as (high, low) with high counting 2^31 units; returns the amount in billions (2 * high + low / 1e9).

comments.text: the units part is offset by 1e9 so that leading zeros are kept, then the leading digit is cut off

GetLargeMoneyString.doc: Formats a (high, low) large money amount as text; optionally with thousands separators and, for amounts of a million or more, abbreviated with ' M'.

GetLargeMoneyUnits.doc: Returns the remainder below one billion of a (high, low) large money amount.

GetNumberString.doc: Formats an integer with the language's thousands separator (text 35:4257).

GetNumberStringSuffixed.doc: Abbreviates a number with K or M suffix and the language's decimal separator (text 4285), e.g. 12.3K, 4.5M.

GetPatchValue.doc: Reads slot index of the patch value array stored under key; returns 0 when absent.

GetSectorNameID.doc: Returns the text id of a sector's name: 1020101 + y*100 + x by default, or the renamed id if one is registered.

GetSubStringSize.doc: Binary search for the longest prefix of text whose rendered width in the given font fits maxWidth. Returns the number of characters.

comments.text: languages 81, 86, 88 (probably Asian languages) get 5x per character

GetTextDisplayDuration.doc: Returns how long text should be shown: per-character time times number of characters, multiplied by 5 for the CJK languages (ids 81, 86, 88).

GetTextLookup.doc: Reads text from page 35; id -1 yields 'text 967/text 998' joined with a slash.

GetTimeString.doc: Formats seconds as hh:mm:ss (hours wrap at 24).

GetVersionString.doc: Maps a build timestamp (seconds since 1970) to the game version name, e.g. 1.0, 2.5.2, 3.2. Builds within an hour of the 3.3 timestamp return '3.3', unknown ones '?'.

InitPatchTable.doc: Resets the patch value table (gPatchTable) to empty.

MeterToString.doc: Formats a distance in metres as text with unit: metres below 1000, otherwise km (page 35 texts 967 and 966) with up to two decimals.

MeterToStringSplit.doc: Same as MeterToString but returns {value text, unit text} separately.

RemovePatchValues.doc: Deletes the patch value array stored under key.

SetPatchValue.doc: Stores a value in the patch table: slot index of the array kept under key, growing the array when needed.

Str2Int.doc: Identity function; used to reinterpret a string value as an integer.

TrimWhitespace.doc: Removes leading and trailing space, tab, CR and LF from a string.

_BeforeSave.doc: Save hook used by the intro classes: frees the text tables before the game writes a save (SE_FreeText).

comments.text: C201 UiTextFonts.Set first, then audio (C200) and C202

_Init.doc: Game start initialisation: sets up the UI text and audio classes, the patch, ship, ware and station tables, the speaker table, the infinite loop and precaches textures.

_Restart.doc: Reinitialises the game after a reload or a restored save: reopens fonts and texts, reloads audio, the patch and game-state classes, updates quests and upgrades, and clears the save-leave flag.

_SaveFinished.doc: Save hook used by the intro classes: reloads the UI texts after a save (C201.RestoreTexts).
